expiryWindowDays.description: Legacy Store setting; ignored by v1.2 scoring. Product.expiryPushDays is authoritative

expiryPushDays.description: Product expiry push threshold in calendar days. Missing or null means 0 (disabled); no Store fallback

stockQuantity.description: Derived sum of inventory batch remainingQuantity values

RecTransactionEvidence.description: Presence counts from one immutable source dataset; ratios displayed at six decimal places, decisions use exact counts

expiryDate.description: Optional unless the product requires expiry tracking

minUtilValue.description: Positive value, at most 6 decimal places; PERCENTAGE in (0,100], ABSOLUTE in frozen weighted utility units

expiringSoonQuantity.description: Sellable quantity expiring strictly after today through the inclusive lookahead date

supportCount.description: Not measured by SPMF; always null
